999008199.text:
みんな、いらっしゃい！
第１回九偉人会を始めるわよ！

localizations.en: Everyone, welcome! I hereby call the first meeting of the Miraculous Nine to order!

999008199.text:
ヴァレリア、説明を求めます。九偉人会とやらの
目的と、そこのヘルト兄様とゼロ姉様について

localizations.en: Valeria, I require an explanation. The purpose of this gathering, and what has become of Held and Zero.

999008199.text:
私もよく分からないんだけどヘルトに元気がないの。
だから美味しいものを食べて元気出してもらおうって

localizations.en: I'm not entirely sure myself, but Held hasn't been himself lately. So I figured a good meal might help bring him back.

999008199.text:
兄者を元気づけようとする、その気持ちやよし！
我の力は兄者の賢い知恵があってこそ輝くからのお！

localizations.en: The spirit behind this effort to restore brother's vigor—admirable! My strength shines brightest when guided by brother's wisdom!

999008199.text:
それに私、果ての大陸へ向けて
一度兄弟全員で集まってみたいと思っていたのよ

localizations.en: And besides, with World's End ahead of us, I've been wanting to get all of us siblings together at least once.

999008199.text:
あの、ヘルト兄貴もゼロ姉貴も、来て大丈夫なの？
王都で囚われてるはずじゃ……

localizations.en: Um... is it really okay for Held and Zero to be here? Weren't they supposed to be... held in the capital...?

999008199.text:
そこはクレオたちが手を回してくれたのよ。
一家団らんは大切だから、特別にって

localizations.en: Creo and the others made arrangements. A family reunion is important, so they made an exception.

999008199.text:
一家団らん……！
いいぞ、兄弟みんな仲良く……！

localizations.en: A family reunion...! Yes, all of us siblings, together in harmony...!

999008199.text:
それで、美味しいものを食べるってことだけど、
もう用意してあるのかい？

localizations.en: So when you say good food—have you actually got something prepared?

999008199.text:
ええ！　ランツェに手伝ってもらって、
私が用意したわ！

localizations.en: Of course! Lanze helped me out, and I took care of everything!

999008199.text:
ヴァレリア姉上の料理……
肉、丸焼き……魚、丸焼き……

localizations.en: Valeria's cooking... Meat, whole-roasted... Fish, whole-roasted...

999008199.text: 我は空腹じゃ！　はよ食事の席に案内せえ！

localizations.en: We are famished! Lead us to the table at once!

999008199.text:
はーい。みんなあっちよ、ついてきて。
ほら、ヘルトも

localizations.en: Alright, alright. Everyone follow me. Come on, Held, you too.

999008199.text:
なんだい、シトリン。
あんな様子でも、ヘル兄が怖いかい？

localizations.en: What's the matter? Even like this—is big brother Held still making you nervous?

999008199.text: ……いや、さすがにそこまでビビりじゃないけど
ただ、調子が狂うなって。それだけ

localizations.en: It's just... something feels off. That's all.
